parameters.name: Conditions
parameters.description:
The rule conditions. Specify a value in the JSON format. You can specify the following keys:

*   **condition**: the matching condition.
*   **type**: the matching type.
*   **value**: the matching value.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description:
The ID of the alert handling rule. 
> You can call the [DescribeImageEventOperationPage](~~DescribeImageEventOperationPage~~) operation to query the ID.

parameters.name: Note
parameters.description: The remarks that you want to add.

parameters.name: Scenarios
parameters.description:
The application scope of the rule. The value is in the JSON format. Valid values:

*   **type**
*   **value**

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source of the whitelist. Valid values:

*   **image**: image.
*   **agentless**: agentless detection.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas update-image-event-operation --id 814163 --scenarios type_:_repo_,_value_:_test-aaa/shenzhen-repo-01 --source agentless --conditions condition_:_MD5_,_type_:_equals_,_value_:_0083a31cc0083a31ccf7c10367a6e0000 --note test --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
